definitions.bpu: device_shared snapshots after warmup; driver averaging window not reset; mean/p95 are complete runner group measurements, not model attribution
definitions.compute_fps: valid_compute_samples*1000/sum(compute_wall_ms); excludes acquisition/save; not actual online throughput
definitions.cpu: process CPU milliseconds / matching wall milliseconds *100; 100%=one core; includes camera SDK and scheduler threads; never add overlapping phase CPU percentages
definitions.legacy_disparity: original camera mode2 enables SDK Q8 producer, included in whole-process measurement; its isolated internal compute time is unavailable; acquire time includes SDK wait/copy/release
definitions.pipeline_fps: successful_measured_frames*1000/measured_wall_ms; real synchronous live camera acquisition+processing+configured_save+logging+result_release; excludes initialization/warmup
definitions.quality: different live captures across methods; no same-frame pairing, no ground truth, no disparity difference score; saved outputs are grouped previews only
definitions.rss: per-frame process RSS KiB; peak RSS includes process initialization and warmup
